spec.data_source: Native Organizations and IAM Identity Center account, permission-set, provisioning and assignment APIs.
spec.predicate: A current bound assignment or provisioned account consumes this permission set. Complete native organization-wide account, assignment and provisioning reads found no current consumer.
spec.title: Identity Center permission set has a consumer across organization accounts
spec.description: Reviews IAM Identity Center permission-set consumers across a complete organization account universe. Native Organizations account lists, instance/permission-set lists, all provisioning states and account assignments must be complete before reporting structural absence. Any verified assignment or provisioned account is a consumer. Denied, incomplete, inconsistent or foreign-scope evidence remains unresolved. This does not measure successful permission use or authorize deletion.
spec.remediation_hint: Review permission-set ownership and intended consumers before retiring an unassigned set.
